title: NotNotes source and estate
body:
Alchemy NotNotes v0.1-dev15 source is published in Git at packages/alchemy_notnotes/ with AlchemyNotNotes.cls, AlchemyNotNotesIntentions.cls, AlchemyNotNotesClustered.cls, tests, demos, DEPENDENCY_LOCK.json and source hashes. Mini NotNotes dev16 is the canonical persistence/application baseline for the Project Alchemy corpus; later application lines must not silently replace its persisted-data reader without qualification.

Source archive SHA-256: 57a7d1b09234621f20c9de5dda312b4e38140b57cb87c45f7318e59730db4488. Git source publication is not runtime acceptance. The independently versioned Project Alchemy working corpus is now v0.7: 954 documents, 34 stacks, 180 components, 202 exact package records, 180 technical-paper records, 224 evidence records, 79 curated interactions and 54 stack-membership records. Its fresh-process qualification ends VERIFY=PASS.
summary: Published NotNotes source is separate from the independently versioned Project Alchemy v0.7 working corpus; v0.7 reopens and verifies 954 documents under the retained dev16 persistence baseline.
invariants: NotNotes alone owns its document truth and revision state
Transport and UI are adapters, not document authorities
Git publication is not installation or runtime acceptance
Working corpus versions are documentary data and do not replace source-package identity

provenance.claim: Published historical source package; not a deployment claim
Working programme/stack corpus; fresh-process qualification reports VERIFY=PASS and TOTAL=954
